payload.title: tenant-scoping-adapter builds finding ids from path and line and observation ids from path, line and method, so two same-method calls on one line emit two findings with one id and two observations with one id, now also through the EntityManager form.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:286-288 (the observation id is path, line and method)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:319 (the raw-query finding id is path and line)
tools/aria-adapters/tenant-scoping-adapter.ts:347 (the unscoped-read finding id is path and line)

payload.rule_violated: An id must identify one finding or observation; two rows with one id lose one of them in any id-keyed consumer.
payload.notes: [await manager.find(A, { where: { id } }), await manager.find(B, { where: { id } })] on one line yields two tenant-repository-unscoped-read:path:line findings with identical id, evidence and message, so the second call (possibly another entity) is never judged separately, and the two observations differ only in details and share one id. None occurs in the real repo today. Close condition: Add the column (and the entity name) to the ids, or number the calls of a line, and add a row with two same-method calls on one line that expects two distinct ids and two distinct observations. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 4). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
